prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium animation art-direction board for the LAST section of the 8x Social website. Landscape 3:2 board, very high fidelity. The attached image is ONLY the authentic original serif 8x mark reference; ignore its orange background. The ending must be warm stone #e9e5dc with carbon black ink; no orange background, no chrome, no bubbles, no random particle cloud. Concept: “Continuous impression”. The large original serif 8x at left is printed in ink. The separate x quietly disappears, and the 8 rotates clockwise with a subtle perspective tilt, staying a cohesive continuous silhouette. A precision halftone screen travels across its surface like a print reveal, revealing perfectly evenly spaced small round black dots locked to the silhouette. The two apertures gently open into a horizontal elegant infinity figure retaining thick/thin calligraphic weight. No free floating dots or tangled strings; pristine graphic motion that can actually be built with SVG masks and transforms.
Composition: top 60% one large finished desktop footer design, left two-thirds beautiful large horizontal dotted infinity with disciplined varying dot sizes and no chaotic particles; right one-third five beautifully typeset stationary product rows: “8x Careers”, “8x Sale”, “8x Social”, “8x Research”, “8x Next”. Use authentic serif 8x prefix from reference and clean Inter product labels. Tiny “Placeholder” by Next only. Underneath on same stone background: original 8x social lower left, “Build your network.” lower right with small arrow. At very bottom small copyright, Contact, LinkedIn, Privacy, Terms, no divider lines.
Bottom 40% contains four evenly sized sequence panels with generous margins: “01 / SIGNATURE” original solid 8x upright; “02 / TURN” original 8 halfway turned, x recedes; “03 / IMPRESSION” horizontally rotated 8 half solid and half precision halftone with a soft but narrow sweep boundary, coherent shape; “04 / INFINITY” beautiful horizontal calligraphic dotted infinity. All stages match the top hero graphic and maintain roughly consistent size. No browser chrome. Quiet confident restrained Swiss editorial art direction, clean negative space, no gratuitous captions, no gradients, no thin ring wireframes. The storyboard must clearly show different intermediate states, not repeat the same infinity four times.
